Specification of Execution Management
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
Execution Management
should ensure that the entire memory range that determin-
istic
processes
may be using is available at the start and for the whole duration of the
respective
process
execution.
Applications not configured to be deterministic may be mapped on-demand.
In order to provide sufficient memory at the beginning of the execution of a
process
,
some properties may need to be defined for each
process
.
